Rules relevant to this task:

+++ b/README.md
@@ -1 +1,20 @@
 # fixture repo
+
+## Running the tests
+
+Tests are run with [pytest](https://docs.pytest.org/):
+
+```sh
+pip install pytest
+pytest
+```
+
+To run a single file or a single test:
+
+```sh
+pytest test_pricing_cache.py
+pytest test_pricing_cache.py::test_lookup_falls_back_to_snapshot
+```
+
+Note: this repository does not contain any test files yet, so `pytest` currently
+collects nothing. Add `test_*.py` files next to the modules they cover.
